answer: Synchronized Proof-of-Space audits resist Sybil attacks among agents inspecting a prism for violet drift or mapping yarrow cover by requiring each peer to commit a Merkle root over a unique, key-salted graph plot and answer concurrent epoch challenges before a strict timeout. Because unique plots prevent deduplication and recomputation misses the deadline, attackers incur dedicated disk capacity and read throughput per alias, though large storage operators can still outscale edge peers.
